_comment: Opencode installer configuration. Edit version and models manually.

asset_patterns._comment: Used for GitHub Releases installs. OpenCode 2 uses platform packages from npm instead.

models: _PLACEHOLDER: replace with provider/model strings, e.g. groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile
_PLACEHOLDER: run install_opencode.py --list-models after install to see available models

providers._comment: Maps opencode provider names to the standard env var each provider expects inside the opencode process. The Self wrapper will map OPENCODE_* namespaced env vars to these at runtime.
